summary.suggested: The Washington Post quoted Billy Madden saying that Tom Allen, who had known Charley Mitchell as a boy in Birmingham, taught Mitchell the left hook that later spread to Dempsey, Corbett and others.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Washington Post, Tuesday, February 1, 1898, page 8.

facts.fact: Allen was one of Charley Mitchell's best friends in America, having known him as a boy around Birmingham, England

Allen gave Charley Mitchell boxing pointers, most notably the deceptive left hook, which Mitchell used on Reddy Gallagher, Jack Burke, Dominick McCaffrey and others; Madden said Allen did not invent the blow

notes: The account is Billy Madden's recollection, so the facts are secondhand.
